title: Unknown or unpaid status ("paused", "drafted") on an activated event is treated as active
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: membership.activated with data.status "paused" (uid qa_tri_22) and "drafted" (uid qa_tri_23)
expected: Unrecognised or unpaid statuses (drafted, paused) must not grant access; fail closed.
actual: Both return {"status":"active"} and access 200. fromWhopStatus returns null for them, so statusFromWebhook falls through to the event-type regex and returns active.
suspected_area: membership.ts statusFromWebhook fallthrough when fromData is null
